quotes.quote: Enovis Expands Spinalogic® Bone Growth Stimulator Indication to Include Cervical Fusion

Dallas, TX — Enovis™ Corporation announced that Spinalogic has received U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) clearance for an expanded indication that includes adjunct use following primary anterior cervical discectomy and fusion (ACDF) surgery of two motion segments, or three vertebrae, from C4–C7 in skeletally mature patients.
